meta.profile_notes: 0.16mm layer height is optimal for a better quality. No support needed. You can decrease the number of walls to 2 and reduce the infill to 5% if you want a lighter model.

meta.profile_title: Larger gap, for big frames 0.16mm layer, 3 walls, 10% infill
meta.profile_notes: This model is designed for glasses with big frames or big temples. The gap is enlarged by 4,5mm (0,177in). 0.16mm layer height is optimal for a better quality. No support needed. You can decrease the number of walls to 2 and reduce the infill to 5% if you want a lighter model.

meta.profile_title: Larger gap and less distance between the gap and the nose
meta.profile_notes: I had the problem that my wife's glasses didn't fit perfectly into the original design because the temple arms of her glasses were too close to the lenses. So I enlarged the cut-out towards the nose to reduce the space between the lens and the temple arm and give the temple arms more room to open towards the ears. When you download the file, you can use the negative body in Bambu Studio to adjust the cut-out to your own needs.

I love this model, but I found it too smooth with the normal print profile. So I created a profile with fuzzy skin. Now it looks more like cat's fur. I printed it in Wood PLA, but it looks just as good with normal PLA.
